extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting to (or reading) the NYC Midnight 100-word Microfiction Challenge
extracted.subtask_description: Short-form fiction entries for the NYC Midnight 100-word Microfiction Challenge: complete microfiction pieces constrained to 100 words. The page lists winning and top stories that meet that length requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length: 100 words
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every listed story is labeled with 'Length: 100 words' indicating the strict length constraint for this challenge; entries must conform to a 100-word limit (examples of winning/top stories provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form/Genre: 100-word Microfiction Challenge
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The challenge is specifically for microfiction—very short fiction told within the 100-word constraint; the page showcases winning/top microfiction examples across years to illustrate the expected format and tone.
